items.title: Does Blackstone (BX) Face A Bigger Risk After Its AI Debt Downgrade?
items.summary: Blackstone (NYSE:BX) now expects Anthropic to carry a junk credit rating after its planned IPO, reversing an earlier investment-grade assumption. The revised outlook increases credit risk on Blackstone-managed funds that hold sizeable exposure to loans funding Anthropic's AI build-out. The downgrade expectation raises questions over how Anthropic will support its large-scale AI expansion through future financing arrangements.
